messages.text:
"**Project:** AI NES Retro Games Creator

Build a complete retro NES gaming platform using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in a single HTML file.

### 1. Game Collection
Create multiple playable NES-style games:
- Super Mario-style platform game
- Contra-style shooting game
- Pac-Man maze game
- Space Invaders
- Tetris
- Snake
- Donkey Kong-style arcade game
- Bomberman-style game
- Racing game
- Brick Breaker
- Flappy Bird-style game
- Adventure dungeon game

Use original characters, graphics, and sounds.

### 2. Keyboard Navigation
Implement complete keyboard controls:

- Arrow Up – Move up
- Arrow Down – Move down
- Arrow Left – Move left
- Arrow Right – Move right
- Enter – Start game / Select
- Escape – Pause / Exit
- Space – Jump / Shoot
- Z – Action
- X – Secondary action
- P – Pause game
- R – Restart game

### 3. Main Menu
Create a beautiful NES console interface:
- Retro 8-bit design
- Game selection menu
- Keyboard navigation
- Game preview
- Start game button
- Sound on/off
- Fullscreen mode
- High-score system

### 4. Gameplay Features
- Smooth keyboard controls
- Pixel-art graphics
- 8-bit sound effects
- Score and lives
- Different levels
- Increasing difficulty
- Collision detection
- Game-over and victory screens
- Responsive mobile controls

### 5. Technical Requirements
- HTML5 Canvas
- CSS3
- Vanilla JavaScript
- No paid API
- No external game engine
- No fake buttons
- Every game must actually be playable.
- Use localStorage for saved scores.
- Support Android and desktop browsers.
- Deliver complete working source code in one HTML file.

**Important:** Build a real multi-game emulator-style arcade collection, not just a static game menu. All games must have independent gameplay logic and working keyboard navigation.
"
